description: This file defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for managing employee work experience records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting work experience data, along with validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for documentation. The class interacts with service and DAO layers to perform CRUD operations on EmpWorkExperience entities.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for Employee Work Experience management, including CRUD operations, validation rules, and OpenAPI documentation annotations. It extends Endpoint and implements the CrudEndpoint interface, managing EmpWorkExperience entities through service and DAO layers.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkExperienceService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of EmployeeWorkExperienceService used for performing service-level operations on employee work experience data.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single employee work experience record based on empNumber and id parameters, returning a resource result with the data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring parameters like ID and empNumber are valid.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all work experience records for a specified employee, supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing records, such as empNumber and sorting parameters.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee work experience record using request data, returning the created entity.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validation rules for creating a new record, including required fields and constraints.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the request body when creating or updating an employee work experience record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee work experience record based on provided ID and request data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules specific to updating existing records, including required ID parameter.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or multiple employee work experience records specified by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation for delete operation, ensuring IDs are provided.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Handles creation or updating of EmpWorkExperience entities based on request data.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
